Imagine what it can do when it's harnessed.|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave27-1.ogg|[[Marcellus]] on Wave 27 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Necromancer''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Necromancer''', was one of the [[Boss]] enemies that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a high amount of health and an average speed. The '''Null Necromancer''' has two abilities. The first ability is ''Summon Gravestones'', which makes it create nine [[Gravestone]]s. These [[Gravestone]]s will in total summon in four [[Giant Skeleton]]s, four [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guards]] and one [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]]. The second ability is ''Dark Projectile'', which makes it fire a projectile at tower or units in its range of 25. This stuns towers for 4 seconds and deals 100 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Necromancer stumbled forward, hands clutching the staff for support. As it raised the staff, tombstones breached the ground and skeletons crawled to the surface. Necromancer smiled. The creature copied something that cost him everything to obtain, and that was unacceptable.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Necromancer''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Necromancer]] tower. It has pink skin and the left side of its body has an exposed purple skeleton. It wears a purple robe, purple cape, grey knee-pads and grey armbands. It has a few spikes coming out of its body. It holds a brown staff with a lantern attached to it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] can kill the '''Null Necromancer''' and its minions. **Stun immune towers can be useful against it, as they cannot be stunned by it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. *The '''Null Necromancer''' summons in multiple [[Gravestone]]s with its ''Summon Gravestones'' ability. **Towers that can deal AOE damage, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] can be helpful at clearing out multiple of them at once. **The [[Hacker]] can be used to convert [[Gravestone]]s, preventing them from summoning anything. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} NullNecrocorpser.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NullNecromancerPI.png|'''Null Necromancer''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Charms}} NullNecromancerCharm.png|'''Null Necromancer''' on the [[Null Necromancer Charm]]. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NullNecromancerIconIG.png|'''Null Necromancer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Necromancer''' has the highest health for a non-major boss when including [[Shield Health]], with 150,000 total health. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Null Necromancer''' added. **{{Bug}} Default [[Shield Health]] of 100,000 is never applied, it only has [[Shield Health]] in modes with specific values set for them. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Now has a default [[Shield Health]] value of 100,000. ==Notes== {{BlindFaith|[[Null Accelerator]]|Wave 25|[[Skeleton]], [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] & Null Necromancer|Wave 27|[[Rift Walker]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
